project.name: BioCloud-IoT-CloudComputing
project.description: BioCloud IoT: Smart Healthcare Monitoring System Cloud Deployment and Orchestration Script using Apache Ant. Integrates Local Node.js PaaS Backend with Cloudflare Global Edge Cloud.

target.description: Displays available Cloud Computing build and deployment targets

Cloud Provider: ${cloud.provider}
